data.name: Final Armada
data.detailed_description:
Final Armada is a space fleet real time strategy roguelike where you build your own ships block by block, command them in real-time battles, and choose your way through battles, events and discoveries as you push farther into the unknown.

Design ships from the ground up by placing hull, armor, weapons, engines, shields, reactors and other systems wherever you want. How you build actually matters. Armor can protect important systems, weapons need room to fire, and losing the wrong part of a ship can completely change how it fights.

Once your fleet is ready, take control and command it through large space battles. Give your ships movement orders, position them, and watch as armor is destroyed, weapons are blown off, and entire sections of ships break apart.

Between battles, choose your path through a branching map filled with fights, upgrades, resources and other events. As you make it farther, you’ll gain access to more of your own ship, open areas that were previously locked, and slowly uncover more about where you are, what happened before you woke up, and why you’re still fighting.

Build your ships. Explore what's left. Keep your fleet alive. Find out why you're still fighting.
